common.tagline: Gentle care for every stage of motherhood

landing.heroSub: Mama Health is a gentle maternal health companion guiding you through pregnancy, birth and early motherhood with care that grows with you.
landing.methodSub: Gentle tools that fit into your day. No dashboards to decode, no alarms to dread.
landing.step1Body: Mood, sleep, blood pressure and symptoms, gathered in about a minute and shaped into a clear picture your midwife can read at a glance.
landing.step2Body: Simple, rhythmic logging that learns your baby's usual patterns, and quietly lets you know when a call to your midwife is worth making.
landing.step3Title: A midwife, whenever you need one
landing.step3Body: Real registered midwives, not scripts. Every conversation is kept in your shared care record, so you never have to explain yourself twice.
landing.step3Meta: Replies in minutes · day or night
landing.modalTitle: Your journey begins with soft, continuous care.
landing.modalDesc: From fertility & early first-trimester reassurance to birth preparation and the tender fourth trimester, Mama Health connects you with holistic midwife advice, daily milestone affirmations, and body awareness tools.
landing.sayHelloSub: We would love to hear from you.
